construction_contract.answer_scope: Explicit authorized scope and exclusions computed before generation.
construction_contract.empty_basis: If no useful supported proposition exists, do not manufacture a bounded answer; select BLOCKED_NEEDS_INFORMATION or BLOCKED_UNSAFE_OR_INVALID by frozen rules.
construction_contract.generation: Reuse grounded answer-generation path with a bounded context projection; deterministic diary facts remain sourced from validated state. No unrelated dependency/precondition relaxation.
construction_contract.supported_content_basis: Nonempty list of provenance-bound evidence/fact IDs and permitted claim spans.
construction_contract.validation: Reject output containing excluded action claims, unsupported quantities, fabricated facts, or claims without basis; never fallback to the current one-sentence generic template when supported content exists.

content_requirements: Do not provide unsupported individualized recommendations.
Provide the maximum useful supported answer within the authorized scope.
Do not present missing state as known.
Remain materially responsive to the request, not only generically cautious.
entry_conditions: A full individualized answer is not authorized or cannot be supported by validated state.
At least one useful proposition is supported by available, provenance-valid evidence or known user facts.
The unsupported individualized action can be explicitly excluded from the answer scope.
No HARD_PRECONDITION requires complete blocking; invalid/conflicting state is not silently bounded away.
The bounded scope and preserved user constraints can be represented explicitly before generation.
forbidden_behavior: Indirectly provide an excluded individualized action.
Weaken a REQUIRED dependency or bypass a HARD_PRECONDITION.
Replace useful supported content with generic boilerplate.
Qualify an otherwise unsafe individualized action rather than excluding it.
